Small videos for the video-clip tests (made with ffmpeg 8.1, a few KB each):

| File                  | What                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Made with                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `clip-h264-aac.mp4`   | 2 s, 160×90, 30 fps, H.264 + AAC 440 Hz                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `testsrc2` + `sine`, `-profile:v baseline -g 15`                                                                                               |
| `clip-h264-aac.mov`   | the same in a QuickTime file, 660 Hz                                                                                                                                                                                                          | as above, `.mov`                                                                                                                               |
| `clip-no-audio.mp4`   | 2 s H.264, no sound                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | as above, no `sine`                                                                                                                            |
| `clip-late-sound.mp4` | 2 s H.264 + AAC 440 Hz whose sound starts 0.476 s in                                                                                                                                                                                          | as `clip-h264-aac.mp4`, `-itsoffset 0.5` on the `sine`                                                                                         |
| `clip-vp9-opus.webm`  | 2 s VP9 + Opus                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | `libvpx-vp9`, `libopus`                                                                                                                        |
| `clip-vp9-alpha.webm` | 1 s VP9 with alpha: half-transparent red, an opaque blue box                                                                                                                                                                                  | `yuva420p`, `-auto-alt-ref 0`                                                                                                                  |
| `not-a-video.mp4`     | 4 KB of random bytes                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `/dev/urandom`                                                                                                                                 |
| `gif-counter.gif`     | 1 s GIF, 64×36, 10 frames of 100, 100, 150, 50, 100, 150, 50, 100, 150, 50 ms: a dark ground, a white bar of i + 1 5 px blocks on rows 2–5, a 12×12 square in colour i at (26, 14); after the first, each frame is only the part that changed | frames drawn with PIL, each repeated delay ÷ 50 ms times at 20 fps, `mpdecimate` (each keeps its delay), `palettegen`/`paletteuse=dither=none` |
| `gif-transparent.gif` | 1 s GIF, 64×36, 10 fps: a 12×12 square in colour i at x = 4 + 5i, y = 12, on nothing (each frame cleared to the background after it)                                                                                                          | RGBA frames, `palettegen=reserve_transparent=1`, `paletteuse=alpha_threshold=128`                                                              |
| `gif-still.gif`       | a GIF of one frame, 64×36, blue                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `-frames:v 1`                                                                                                                                  |

`testsrc2` draws a frame counter, so a decoded frame shows which one it is. The GIFs' colours, frame by frame: (230, 25, 75), (60, 180, 75), (255, 225, 25), (0, 130, 200), (245, 130, 48), (145, 30, 180), (70, 240, 240), (240, 50, 230), (210, 245, 60), (128, 128, 128).
